exposure: Type of intramural myoma (cavity-distorting vs. non-cavity-distorting)
cohort: 83 women with unexplained infertility and intramural myomas who underwent myomectomy.
finding: Myomectomy significantly improved the overall spontaneous pregnancy rate in women with unexplained infertility and intramural myomas, with greater benefits observed for younger patients and those with cavity-distorting myomas compared to non-cavity-distorting myomas.
